titles.romaji: Boku no Hero Academia THE MOVIE: YOU'RE NEXT - A PIECE OF CAKE
titles.native: 僕のヒーローアカデミア THE MOVIE ユアネクスト《A PIECE OF CAKE》

description: Animation included with the PLUS ULTRA version of the Boku no Hero Academia THE MOVIE: YOU'RE NEXT Blu-ray/DVD release. The OVA is an adaptation of the "A Piece of Cake" one-shot from the Vol. Next booklet that was given out during the movie's theatrical run.
